title: Common-atlas point identities and comparison of detected open subsets
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. All schemes are over $S$ in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $|E|$ for its field-valued point classes and $|t|:|T|\to|E|$ for the map of a scheme-source morphism, as in [def-a1-algebraic-space-point-classes]. Let $w:h_W\to E$ and $p:h_V\to E$ be representable surjective etale morphisms from schemes. The sheaf fibre product $Q=W\times_EV$ is represented by a scheme, and its projections $a:Q\to W$ and $b:Q\to V$ are surjective etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], hence continuous open maps on scheme points. For every subset $A\subseteq|E|$ one has $$ |a|\bigl(|b|^{-1}(|p|^{-1}(A))\bigr)=|w|^{-1}(A),\qquad |b|\bigl(|a|^{-1}(|w|^{-1}(A))\bigr)=|p|^{-1}(A). $$ Every pair $(x,y)\in|W|\times|V|$ with $|w|(x)=|p|(y)$ is the pair of projections of some point of $Q$. In particular $|w|^{-1}(A)$ is open in $W$ if and only if $|p|^{-1}(A)$ is open in $V$. No topology on $|E|$ is assumed in these assertions.

source.place: Tag 03BX (lemma-topology-points), proof: comparison of presentations through their fibre product; Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), the common-field point-lifting argument.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-space-fibre-product-point] to W,V,w,p to obtain one representing scheme Q, its two projections a,b, and lifting for compatible common-field maps. For each of the properties etale and surjective, apply the scheme-test definition [def-trf-algebraic-space] to p along w and to w along p. Yoneda full faithfulness and uniqueness of the representing pullback identify each test projection with a or b up to a scheme isomorphism. Both properties respect isomorphisms, so a and b are surjective etale.

The maps $|a|$ and $|b|$ are continuous because $a,b$ are scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme]. They are open by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map], applied to the two etale scheme projections of Step 1.

source.place: Tag 03WT (lemma-etale-open), used in the common-presentation square of Tag 03BX.

proof.text: The common-field relation of [def-a1-algebraic-space-point-classes] is an equivalence relation: reflexivity uses identity maps, symmetry interchanges them, and transitivity takes the scheme fibre product of two field spectra over the middle representative field. Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback supplies a point of that fibre product, since the middle field spectrum has a unique point. The residue field of this point, together with the two projection maps, gives a common extension; functoriality gives agreement of the two restricted values. Thus equality in the generated quotient implies this relation. Apply it to the canonical residue-field representatives of x and y. Composing the resulting maps with the residue-field maps to W and V gives the common-field input of the lifting clause from [lem-a1-space-fibre-product-point], and hence a point of Q above x,y.

For a scheme morphism k:U→V and a presheaf map t:h_V→F, naturality and the canonical residue-field map κ(k(x))→κ(x) show that schemePointMap(yoneda.map k ≫ t)(x)=schemePointMap(t)(k(x)); their canonical representatives are related by the common field κ(x), as in [def-a1-algebraic-space-point-classes]. Apply this to a,w and b,p and use commutativity of the representing square. For B=|w|⁻¹(A), C=|p|⁻¹(A), this gives |a|⁻¹(B)=|b|⁻¹(C). Surjectivity of a,b then gives |a|(|b|⁻¹(C))=B and |b|(|a|⁻¹(B))=C by the elementary image-preimage identity.

If $B$ is open, continuity of $|a|$ makes $|a|^{-1}(B)$ open in $Q$. Its image under the open map $|b|$ is $C$ by Step 4, so $C$ is open. Conversely, if $C$ is open, take its inverse image by $|b|$ and then its image by $|a|$ to obtain the open subset $B$. This proves the equivalence using only scheme topologies.

lean.statement: theorem exists_atlas_point_comparison {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : AlgebraicSpace S) (W V : Over S) (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ E.obj.obj) (p : yoneda.obj V ⟶ E.obj.obj) (hw : IsEtale w) (hsw : IsSurjective w) (hp : IsEtale p) (hsp : IsSurjective p) : ∃ (Q : Over S) (a : Q ⟶ W) (b : Q ⟶ V), IsPullback (yoneda.map a) (yoneda.map b) w p ∧ Etale a.left ∧ Surjective a.left ∧ Etale b.left ∧ Surjective b.left ∧ Continuous a.left ∧ IsOpenMap a.left ∧ Continuous b.left ∧ IsOpenMap b.left ∧ (∀ (x : W.left) (y : V.left), schemePointMap w x = schemePointMap p y → ∃ z : Q.left, a.left z = x ∧ b.left z = y) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Point E.obj.obj), a.left '' (b.left ⁻¹' (schemePointMap p ⁻¹' A)) = schemePointMap w ⁻¹' A ∧ b.left '' (a.left ⁻¹' (schemePointMap w ⁻¹' A)) = schemePointMap p ⁻¹' A ∧ (IsOpen (schemePointMap w ⁻¹' A) ↔ IsOpen (schemePointMap p ⁻¹' A)))
